summary:
Comprehensive design and architectural implementation plan for the major UI overhaul of OneFocus:
- Minimalist huge bold text design inspired by user mockups (clean white canvas, bold black geometric typography, zero visual clutter).
- Removal of top navigation bar and Work/Life context switcher, consolidating into a pure single focus stream.
- Progressive disclosure: live word count feedback ('Minimum 6 words | Current #'), duration picker appearing only after typing, and optional secondary tasks revealed only after the priority is set.
- Bottom navigation with settings gear on the left, caret shelf toggle in the center, and action button on the right.
- Shelf slide-up drawer with radio item completion and duration tags.
- Direct inline editing with instant return to the setup screen.
- Locked mode focusing purely on the big priority, with completion unlocking the Day Won screen to reveal optional secondary tasks.
- Settings modal housing New Day, Emergency Unlock, Brave-compatible desktop push reminders, and sound controls.
